subject.title: fix: tighten processSchema offset/limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the process tool reject fractional offset and limit values at the model-facing schema boundary, rather than continue accepting and flooring them at runtime?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally coherent, but choosing rejection deliberately narrows an accepted tool-input contract and repository evidence does not establish that this compatibility change is already approved policy.

options.title: Approve integer-only contract
options.body: Accept the schema tightening after real process-tool proof confirms valid integer behavior and clear fractional rejection.

options.title: Keep runtime normalization
options.body: Retain Type.Number and close or revise this PR because fractional values remain accepted and deterministically floored.

recommendation.title: Approve integer-only contract
recommendation.body: Accept the schema tightening after real process-tool proof confirms valid integer behavior and clear fractional rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history for the process-tool implementation and its schema/runtime ownership points to steipete.
